pages.title: Virtual Net Metering in California: VNEM, VNBT and NEMA
pages.note: Full rewrite. Removed unsourced/incorrect claims (a 'VNBT-A' tariff name; 'PG&E Schedule NEM-V'; AB 2175 described as expanding VNEM). AB 2175 is real (chaptered 7/16/2026, ch. 94) but only requires CPUC to make logistics/manufacturing businesses eligible for meter aggregation if it extends the program. Renders HubSpokeLinks for nem and commercial (page is a spoke of both).
